domain.completeness: not assumed; a partial preorder is allowed
domain.populations: every finite multiset of welfare levels, including the empty population
domain.relation: reflexive/transitive closure of the primitive weak edges; pulled back to individuated lives by welfare profile
domain.welfare_chain: the bi-integer indexed chain W_i for every i in Z (no minimum, no maximum)

lemmas.negative_persistence: L1: every population reachable from a VRC image of the frozen witness keeps N >= 1 and Psi = N - H >= 1
lemmas.no_cycle: (S): a directed cycle needs a size-increasing edge; the unique such schema is nonempty-bag VRC, whose negative-free source cannot be recovered once (L1) holds
lemmas.psi_is_not_monotone: Psi falls by one at a ranged NE step with middle -1 and y <= -2 (the exact case P23 flagged below W_-1); it never falls below 1, and Psi = 1 - H with a single negative is unreachable, which is what blocks the last-negative-removing GNEP

model.antisymmetry: the closure is acyclic (no directed cycle), hence a partial preorder
model.construction: least reflexive/transitive closure of the primitive ED, ranged NE, GNEP, VRC and 2003 weak-DA weak edges
model.ed_strictness: a strict ED edge l -> r has no return path r ->* l, since l -> r ->* l would be a cycle
model.extends: the P23 one-sided-chain model now covers the whole bi-integer chain; no minimum level is needed

p23_gap_addressed.prior: P23: the bi-integer chain is not covered because ranged NE at x = 0 with y <= -2 lowers Psi
p23_gap_addressed.resolution: Psi does fall there, but the proof needs only Psi >= 1 and negative persistence; the model therefore extends below W_-1 without a minimum level

checks.egalitarian_dominance: an ED source is perfectly equal; N >= 1 forces its level < 0, so every target life is negative and no target high exists
checks.gnep: z >= 0 keeps E's negatives; z = -1 erases the last negative only when E is negative-free, which forces Psi(source) = 1 - n - H(E) <= 0 and contradicts Psi >= 1
checks.ranged_ne: y < m and D in R(y, m+1): middle < 0 keeps N >= 1 (x = 0 lowers N by one from a source with >= 2 negative middle lives and an all-nonpositive background); middle >= 0 with a negative background forces y < 0, so every gained high brings a negative
checks.vrc_image: N >= 1 and Psi >= 1 for every legal low bag size (empty included)
checks.vrc_source: no invariant (post-VRC) state is a VRC source: z >= 4, n >= 1 gives N = 0
checks.weak_da: C is positive, so a negative source life lies in B; every A life is strictly below it, hence A is entirely negative with no high and Psi(A) = |A| >= 1 (no bound on Psi(source) is used)

invariant_per_schema.engine: Z3 SMT, all integer level parameters and all legal background sizes
invariant_per_schema.necessity_control: without the Psi >= 1 half, GNEP z = -1 with a negative-free background reaches a negative-free target (satisfiable control), so the hypothesis is load-bearing

witness_quantifiers_discharged.dominance-addition-2003: no existential; C ranges over positive bags
witness_quantifiers_discharged.non-elitism: n = 1 (ranged background, uniform in the frozen translation)

path_closure.consequence: reachable-from-a-VRC-image implies N >= 1 and Psi >= 1, so no such state is a negative-free VRC source
path_closure.cycle_argument: a closed walk returns to its start size, so it must contain a size-increasing edge; the unique size-increasing schema is VRC with a nonempty low bag, whose source is a negative-free positive singleton; after its image no VRC is applicable and (L1) keeps a negative forever, so the walk can never return to that source
path_closure.engine: Z3 Spacer constrained-Horn induction over every finite path length

size_effects.arrhenius-2003:dominance-addition: decreases |P| by |C| when C nonempty, else preserves
size_effects.arrhenius-2003:vrc-avoidance: increases |P| by |B| when B nonempty, else preserves

analytic.empty_clause_reason: F strictly increasing on Z: empty-C DA has termwise a_i < b_i, so Phi(A) < Phi(b); empty-B VRC sends a positive singleton to W_-1, and F(-1) < F(z) for z >= u = 4
analytic.full_chain_potential: F(0) = 0, F(t+1) - F(t) = g(t) = 1 + 1/(1 + 2**t), 1 < g < 2 and g strictly decreasing, so F is strictly increasing on all of Z

p21_machine_certificate.engine: Z3 exact SMT and Spacer constrained-Horn induction

result.question: Do ED, thesis ranged Non-Elitism, 2003 GNEP, 2003 VRC avoidance and 2003 positive weak Dominance Addition admit an all-size model over every finite multiset on the full bi-integer indexed welfare chain W_i (i in Z)?
result.scope: the model is exhibited at the frozen witness and satisfies the reviewed frozen translation; other legal witnesses and non-indexed welfare levels are not addressed

source_permitted_empty_cases.da_empty_a_and_b: a positive bag C is at least as good as the empty population; the empty population has only its reflexive edge, so it is a sink and closes no cycle
source_permitted_empty_cases.da_empty_c: b -> A with |A| = |b| and every A life below every b life; size-preserving and strictly lowers Phi, and (L1) still routes a negative source through B
source_permitted_empty_cases.fidelity_branch: handled separately from the frozen nonempty-bag translation
source_permitted_empty_cases.promotion_note: these clauses are not folded into the frozen scanner or a promoted claim without a superseding formalization decision and an independent checker
source_permitted_empty_cases.vrc_empty_b: z >= u descends to the negative singleton W_x; already a weak ED edge, size-preserving, and its image still satisfies (L1)
